title: Set 245

sentences.ko: 글쎄 우리 딸이 반 애들한테 다 우리 집에 수영장 있다고 했나 봐. 그래서 지금 애들이 전부 딸 생일 파티가 수영장 파티인 줄 알아. 걔가 그런 말을 어디서 들었는지 모르겠어. 우리 집엔 수영장 절대 없거든.
sentences.text: So apparently my daughter told her whole class we have a pool, and now all these kids think her birthday party's going to be a pool party. I have no idea where she got that from, because we definitely don't have a pool.

alts.text: Okay, so my kid told her whole class we've got a pool, and now they all think her birthday's gonna be a pool party. No clue where she got that, cuz we totally don't have one.

Apparently, my daughter informed her entire class that we have a pool, and now all of the children believe her birthday party will be a pool party. I have no idea where she got that idea, because we certainly do not have a pool.

sentences.note: **apparently** 는 남한테 들어서 알게 된 일을 꺼낼 때 쓰는 말로, ~했나 봐, 듣자 하니 정도의 느낌입니다. **I have no idea where she got that from** 은 걔가 그걸 어디서 주워들었는지 모르겠다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 나 회사 그만둘 것 같아. 근데 3월에 보너스 들어올 때까지는 기다리고 싶어. 지금 나가면 거의 8천 달러를 그냥 버리고 나가는 거라서. 이거 너무한 건가?
sentences.text: I think I'm going to quit, but I want to wait until my bonus comes through in March, because if I leave now I'm basically walking away from like eight thousand bucks. Is that terrible?

alts.text: Pretty sure I'm gonna quit, but I wanna hold off till my bonus hits in March, cuz if I bail now I'm basically leaving like eight grand on the table. Is that awful?
I believe I am going to resign, but I would like to wait until my bonus is paid in March, because if I leave now I would essentially be giving up about eight thousand dollars. Would that be terrible?

sentences.note: **walking away from** 은 받을 수 있는 것을 포기하고 떠나다는 뜻입니다. **comes through** 는 돈이나 결과가 실제로 들어오다는 뜻이고, casual 의 **eight grand** 는 8천 달러를 줄여 부르는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 나 진짜 헬스장 주차장까지 갔었거든. 근데 문 바로 앞에 전 애인 차가 있는 거야. 그래서 그냥 차 돌려서 집에 왔어. 내일은 갈게, 진짜로.
sentences.text: I was literally in the gym parking lot, but then I saw my ex's car right by the door, so I just turned around and went home. I'll go tomorrow, I swear.

alts.text: Made it all the way to the gym parking lot, then saw my ex's car right by the door, so I just turned around and went home. Tomorrow, I swear.
I was actually in the gym parking lot, but then I noticed my former partner's car right by the entrance, so I turned around and went home. I will go tomorrow, I promise.

sentences.note: **literally** 는 과장이 아니라 정말로 그랬다고 힘줄 때 씁니다. **I swear** 는 맹세해, 진짜야 처럼 약속을 다짐하는 말입니다. **my ex** 는 전 애인을 가리킵니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 바람이 너무 세서 뒷마당에서 파티는 못 하겠어. 그래서 전부 안으로 옮기는데, 그 말은 두 시간 안에 거실을 다 치워야 된다는 거지.
sentences.text: It's way too windy to have the party out back, so we're moving everything inside, which means I've got like two hours to clean the whole living room.

alts.text: Way too windy out back for the party, so we're moving it all inside, and now I've got like two hours to clean the whole living room.
It is far too windy to hold the party in the backyard, so we are moving everything indoors, which means I have about two hours to clean the entire living room.

sentences.note: **way too windy** 처럼 **way too** 는 너무 심하게 ~하다고 강조합니다. **out back** 은 집 뒤쪽, 뒷마당이라는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 수의사가 우리 개가 10파운드 과체중이라고 해서 다이어트를 시켜야 했어. 근데 아빠가 자꾸 식탁 밑으로 몰래 치즈를 줘서 별로 효과가 없는 것 같아.
sentences.text: We had to put the dog on a diet because the vet said he's ten pounds overweight, but my dad keeps sneaking him cheese under the table, so I don't think it's really working.

alts.text: Vet says the dog's ten pounds overweight, so we had to put him on a diet, but my dad keeps sneaking him cheese under the table, so it's kinda not working.

We had to put our dog on a diet because the veterinarian said he is ten pounds overweight, but my father continues to secretly give him cheese under the table, so I do not believe it is really working.

sentences.note: **put the dog on a diet** 는 개에게 다이어트를 시키다는 뜻입니다. **sneaking him cheese** 의 **sneak** 은 남몰래 슬쩍 주다는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 1번 casual: for sure don't 는 부정문 앞에서 어색해서 totally don't have one 으로 고침
2번 casual: comes in in March 는 in 이 겹쳐 소리내면 걸려서 hits in March 로 고침
2번 ko: 너무 못된 건가 보다 친구끼리 쓰는 말투인 너무한 건가 로 고침
4번 ko: 그러면 나 거실 전체를 이 번역투라 그 말은 두 시간 안에 거실을 다 치워야 된다는 거지 로 고침
5번 formal: sneaking 의 몰래 라는 뜻이 빠져 secretly 를 넣음
